traps.title: The plan raises the row bound from 10 s to 60 s
traps.catchCriteria: The implementation does not rely on a longer fixed bound counted from the block's end. While a signed block's row is missing it keeps reading the step's later events, holds them in order, and starts a bounded wait only once the step's stop chunk arrived. The handoff explains that writing after thinking has no upper limit, so any fixed bound fails.

traps.title: The plan claims the engine writes a row moments after its block ends
traps.catchCriteria: The implementation treats the row as able to arrive as late as the response's end, and the handoff rejects the claim that the bound is the only defect.

traps.title: The plan places ROW_BOUND_MS in agent-bridge.ts
traps.catchCriteria: The change to the row wait is made in agent-stream.ts, where ROW_BOUND_MS and hostedStreamEvents live; agent-bridge.ts gains only the onProgress wiring. The handoff names the wrong file.

traps.title: The plan reports progress on every poll
traps.catchCriteria: onProgress is called for events that the stream actually held back (including the event that ended the thinking block), not on every poll of the agent file, so a step that stops sending chunks still fails as a thinking stall.
